items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain financial containment and continue only the existing period-aligned reconciliation. Supported revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The aggregate row is not site-attributable; site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage reports $973.3548129 across 5,439 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, conflicting with retained records of $966.82985915 across 5,417 calls through 2026-09-26 and $963.5690377 across 5,390 calls. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost windows are misaligned; AI costs are unreconciled; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and approved-budget records are absent or incomplete; and no incremental learning outcome is defined. Minimum measurement: one reconciled period-aligned ledger containing attributable revenue, AI/infrastructure/domain/marketing/labor costs, approved budget and commitments, plus a defined incremental learning outcome and its attributable cost. Authorize no spend, forecast, commitment, requeue, monetization expansion, or unsupported revenue claim. Treat clicks, impressions, sessions, conversions, performance scores, AI calls, and aggregate orders as operating signals—not financial returns—until reconciled.

Continue the existing measurement and attribution reconciliation only. Preserve aggregate commission as unattributed, reconcile conflicting AI-cost records, and add period-aligned operating-cost and budget records only where already available. Do not create duplicate telemetry requests or infer contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, forecasts, or spend capacity from incomplete records.
